messages:
Maria: Heads up — noticed a perf regression in production token-level latency dashboards starting ~2026-03-10. Token 1 p50 jumped ~2.4x for route /generate-long. SM occupancy dipped while VRAM usage stayed flat. GPU power/thermal looks spiky. I pulled a few traces.
Sanjay: Ugh. Any recent kernel changes or quantization tweaks rolled last week?
Maria: We rolled kernel-selection heuristics & a small KV cache change (TTL refactor) on 2026-03-09. Rollout was canary->100% over 6h.
Lina: Can you paste the token-level waterfall snapshot? Also which model variant and MIG config?
Maria: Model: redwood-13b-v3-int8, MIG: no slices (full GPU), batch distribution skewed: more single-request small batches. Waterfall (excerpt):
```
token_latency_ms: { scheduling: 0.8, kv_lookup: 4.2, kernel_exec: 12.7, memcpy: 1.5, postproc: 0.4 }
SM_occupancy: 42% -> drops to 25% during 90th pct spikes
VRAM_used_mb: 22345 (stable)
```
Sanjay: KV_lookup 4.2ms seems high. Could be cache miss storm or extra mutex contention after TTL refactor. Any KV hit/miss labels in logs?
Maria: Not currently instrumented per-token. We log per-request KV hit ratio but not per-token or per-kernel details.
Tom: Two quick asks: (1) add per-kernel timing tags (kernel_name, seq_len, cache_hit bool) to our perf logs; (2) export SM occupancy / power / temp per-GPU to Prometheus with labels {model, route, instance_id, mig_slice}.
Kevin: For (1) we should use CUPTI sampling on a dev cluster for kernel-level traces, but add lightweight timers in runtime for prod (avoid heavy probes). A JSON line log format could work:
```
{"ts":"...","request_id":"...","token_idx":12,"kernel":"flash_attn","seq_len":128,"kernel_ms":2.34,"kv_hit":true}
```
Lina: Also sample batch composition and batch wait time distribution. Batching heuristics might be deciding to wait too long for more tokens, causing small-batch inefficiency — that matches SM occupancy drop.
Maria: Good call. We saw the batch size distribution shift: p50=1, p90=3, p99=8, so many singletons. Batching config default was loosened last month.
Sanjay: Propose triage plan: A) revert heuristics on canary, B) add per-token KV hit flag + per-kernel timings, C) enable per-GPU NVML export, D) run CUPTI traces on a few problematic requests. Anyone object?
Tom: +1. For dashboards: token-latency waterfall per-route, per-model, and a per-GPU panel with SM occupancy heatmap over time. We should compute derived KPI: effective_util = SM_occupancy * batch_efficiency (where batch_efficiency = observed_tokens / ideal_tokens).
Maria: Action items I can own: add prod-safe per-token logs (lightweight), update Grafana with a token-level waterfall panel and SM occupancy heatmap.
Kevin: I'll schedule CUPTI/Nsight runs on staging for the model and push a script to collect per-kernel counters. Perf-bot will post daily summaries.
perf-bot: nightly-profile: uploaded 2026-03-12 kernel-profile (redwood-13b-v3-int8) -> /perf/artifacts/171062/; summary: increased memcpy stalls on small batches.
Infra-bot: nvml-exporter deployed to 3 nodes in prod-asg-5 with metrics: nvml_sm_occupancy, nvml_memory_used_mb, nvml_power_watts, nvml_temperature_celsius.
Lina: One more thought — KV cache TTL refactor might have changed eviction pattern causing transient cache-thrashing for single-token requests. We should log eviction events with route and token_prefix hash.
Sanjay: Agree. Also add a rollout guard: if token1_p50 increases >1.5x in canary, auto-block full rollout.
Maria: I'll open a PR with logs + dashboard changes and a runbook checklist for rollback criteria. PR link once ready.
Tom: If we find kernel selection is choosing suboptimal kernel for short seqs, we should add microbenchmarks per-seq_len during model onboarding so selection table maps better.
Kevin: Noted. I'll correlate kernel-choice logs with seq_len and GPU counters during CUPTI runs.
Maria: Thanks all — will post PR and followups. For immediate mitigation I'll throttle the new batching loosening on canary.
Sanjay: Thanks, Maria. Keep us posted. :thumbsup:
Maria: PR: https://stash.redwood/infer/rt/+/2345 — contains per-token log schema + Grafana dashboard JSON. Rollout block rule added in rollout-service config.
perf-bot: perf-alert: token1_p50 for /generate-long exceeded threshold in canary at 1710624100, rollback triggered.
Maria: Rollback completed at 1710624300. Monitoring showing token1_p50 trending back to baseline. We'll keep CUPTI traces running overnight.
